import R49EventETwoEdgeTriplePrefix
import R50EventETripleHostFreezeNormalForm

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace ChompLean

/-!
R50: exact host-column geometry of the maximal-defect triple-prefix value.

A value `p<s+3` occurring in the strict prefixes of three consecutive rows
has a host-change pattern determined exactly by the row at which its
row-start owner is reached:

* `p<=s`: no change;
* `p=s+1`: one change, then the host freezes;
* `p=s+2`: two changes and three pairwise-distinct hosts.

The low branches are recurrence carries.  The change at the owner row is
forced by `rowstart_no_middle`; the pre-owner change is forced by the
same-lower no-repeat law.
-/

/-- Exact owner-time host-change invariant for three consecutive rows. -/
def ThreeConsecutiveHostGeometry
    (s p g b1 b2 : Nat) : Prop :=
  p ≤ s + 2 ∧ g < p ∧ b1 < p ∧ b2 < p ∧
    (g = b1 ↔ p ≤ s) ∧
    (b1 = b2 ↔ p ≤ s + 1) ∧
    (g = b2 ↔ p ≤ s) ∧
    ((p ≤ s ∧ g = b1 ∧ b1 = b2) ∨
      (p = s + 1 ∧ g ≠ b1 ∧ b1 = b2) ∨
      (p = s + 2 ∧ g ≠ b1 ∧ b1 ≠ b2 ∧ g ≠ b2))

/-- Generic three-row host theorem for the actual game.  This is independent
of event E and only assumes that the common value lies below `s+3`. -/
theorem gameF_three_consecutive_prefix_host_geometry
    {s p g b1 b2 : Nat}
    (hg : g < s) (hb1 : b1 < s + 1) (hb2 : b2 < s + 2)
    (h0 : gameF s g = p)
    (h1 : gameF (s + 1) b1 = p)
    (h2 : gameF (s + 2) b2 = p)
    (hceil : p < s + 3) :
    ThreeConsecutiveHostGeometry s p g b1 b2 := by
  have hgp : g < p := by
    have hgt := gameRecurrenceModel.value_gt_index
      (q := s) (r := g) (Nat.le_of_lt hg)
    change g < gameF s g at hgt
    rw [h0] at hgt
    exact hgt
  have hb1p : b1 < p := by
    have hgt := gameRecurrenceModel.value_gt_index
      (q := s + 1) (r := b1) (Nat.le_of_lt hb1)
    change b1 < gameF (s + 1) b1 at hgt
    rw [h1] at hgt
    exact hgt
  have hb2p : b2 < p := by
    have hgt := gameRecurrenceModel.value_gt_index
      (q := s + 2) (r := b2) (Nat.le_of_lt hb2)
    change b2 < gameF (s + 2) b2 at hgt
    rw [h2] at hgt
    exact hgt
  have hpBound : p ≤ s + 2 := by omega
  have hcases : p ≤ s ∨ p = s + 1 ∨ p = s + 2 := by omega
  rcases hcases with hpLow | hpCases
  · have hcarry1 : gameF (s + 1) g = p := by
      have hsmall : gameRecurrenceModel.f s g < s + 1 := by
        change gameF s g < s + 1
        rw [h0]
        omega
      have hconst := constant_from gameRecurrenceModel
        hg hsmall 1
      change gameF (s + 1) g = gameF s g at hconst
      rw [h0] at hconst
      exact hconst
    have hcarry2 : gameF (s + 2) g = p := by
      have hsmall : gameRecurrenceModel.f s g < s + 1 := by
        change gameF s g < s + 1
        rw [h0]
        omega
      have hconst := constant_from gameRecurrenceModel
        hg hsmall 2
      change gameF (s + 2) g = gameF s g at hconst
      rw [h0] at hconst
      exact hconst
    have hgb1 : g = b1 :=
      gameRecurrenceModel.fixed_q_injective
        (q := s + 1) (b₁ := g) (b₂ := b1)
        (by omega) (Nat.le_of_lt hb1) (hcarry1.trans h1.symm)
    have hgb2 : g = b2 :=
      gameRecurrenceModel.fixed_q_injective
        (q := s + 2) (b₁ := g) (b₂ := b2)
        (by omega) (Nat.le_of_lt hb2) (hcarry2.trans h2.symm)
    have hb1b2 : b1 = b2 := hgb1.symm.trans hgb2
    exact ⟨hpBound, hgp, hb1p, hb2p,
      ⟨fun _ => hpLow, fun _ => hgb1⟩,
      ⟨fun _ => by omega, fun _ => hb1b2⟩,
      ⟨fun _ => hpLow, fun _ => hgb2⟩,
      Or.inl ⟨hpLow, hgb1, hb1b2⟩⟩
  · rcases hpCases with hpOwner1 | hpOwner2
    · have hgb1 : g ≠ b1 := by
        intro heq
        subst b1
        have hstart : gameF (s + 1) g = s + 1 := by
          simpa [hpOwner1] using h1
        have hmiddle : gameF s g ≠ s + 1 :=
          gameRecurrenceModel.rowstart_no_middle
            hstart hg (by omega)
        exact hmiddle (by simpa [hpOwner1] using h0)
      have hcarry2 : gameF (s + 2) b1 = p := by
        have hsmall : gameRecurrenceModel.f (s + 1) b1 < s + 2 := by
          change gameF (s + 1) b1 < s + 2
          rw [h1]
          omega
        have hconst := constant_from gameRecurrenceModel
          hb1 hsmall 1
        change gameF (s + 2) b1 = gameF (s + 1) b1 at hconst
        rw [h1] at hconst
        exact hconst
      have hb1b2 : b1 = b2 :=
        gameRecurrenceModel.fixed_q_injective
          (q := s + 2) (b₁ := b1) (b₂ := b2)
          (by omega) (Nat.le_of_lt hb2) (hcarry2.trans h2.symm)
      have hgb2 : g ≠ b2 := by
        intro heq
        apply hgb1
        exact heq.trans hb1b2.symm
      exact ⟨hpBound, hgp, hb1p, hb2p,
        ⟨fun heq => False.elim (hgb1 heq), fun hle => by omega⟩,
        ⟨fun _ => by omega, fun _ => hb1b2⟩,
        ⟨fun heq => False.elim (hgb2 heq), fun hle => by omega⟩,
        Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hpOwner1, hgb1, hb1b2⟩)⟩
    · have hgb1 : g ≠ b1 := by
        intro heq
        subst b1
        exact encoding_same_lower_no_repeat game_encodes
          hg (by omega) (by omega) h0 h1
      have hb1b2 : b1 ≠ b2 := by
        intro heq
        subst b2
        have hstart : gameF (s + 2) b1 = s + 2 := by
          simpa [hpOwner2] using h2
        have hmiddle : gameF (s + 1) b1 ≠ s + 2 :=
          gameRecurrenceModel.rowstart_no_middle
            hstart hb1 (by omega)
        exact hmiddle (by simpa [hpOwner2] using h1)
      have hgb2 : g ≠ b2 := by
        intro heq
        subst b2
        have hstart : gameF (s + 2) g = s + 2 := by
          simpa [hpOwner2] using h2
        have hmiddle : gameF s g ≠ s + 2 :=
          gameRecurrenceModel.rowstart_no_middle
            hstart hg (by omega)
        exact hmiddle (by simpa [hpOwner2] using h0)
      exact ⟨hpBound, hgp, hb1p, hb2p,
        ⟨fun heq => False.elim (hgb1 heq), fun hle => by omega⟩,
        ⟨fun heq => False.elim (hb1b2 heq), fun hle => by omega⟩,
        ⟨fun heq => False.elim (hgb2 heq), fun hle => by omega⟩,
        Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨hpOwner2, hgb1, hb1b2, hgb2⟩)⟩

/-- Quantitative form: the three occurrences use exactly `p-s+1` distinct
host columns (one, two, or three in the three owner-time branches). -/
theorem threeConsecutiveHostGeometry_distinct_column_count
    {s p g b1 b2 : Nat}
    (hgeo : ThreeConsecutiveHostGeometry s p g b1 b2) :
    ([g, b1, b2].eraseDups).length = p - s + 1 := by
  rcases hgeo with
    ⟨_hpBound, _hgp, _hb1p, _hb2p,
      _hfirstIff, _hsecondIff, _hspanIff, hcases⟩
  rcases hcases with hlow | howner1 | howner2
  · rcases hlow with ⟨hps, hgb1, hb1b2⟩
    subst b1
    subst b2
    simp [List.eraseDups_cons]
    omega
  · rcases howner1 with ⟨hp, hgb1, hb1b2⟩
    subst p
    subst b2
    have hb1g : b1 ≠ g := Ne.symm hgb1
    simp [List.eraseDups_cons, hb1g]
  · rcases howner2 with ⟨hp, hgb1, hb1b2, hgb2⟩
    subst p
    have hb1g : b1 ≠ g := Ne.symm hgb1
    have hb2g : b2 ≠ g := Ne.symm hgb2
    have hb2b1 : b2 ≠ b1 := Ne.symm hb1b2
    simp [List.eraseDups_cons, hb1g, hb2g, hb2b1]

/-- Maximal-defect event-E specialization.  The R49 survivor receives
concrete hosts on rows `s+1,s+2`, and their equality/change pattern is exact,
not merely a disjunction of possible rehosts. -/
theorem gameF_margin_eventE_maximal_defect_triple_host_geometry
    (hU : UnitDip gameRecurrenceModel) {s : Nat}
    (hdip : gameF (s + 1) (s + 1) < gameF s s)
    (hmargin : s = 0 ∨
      ∃ j, s = j + 1 ∧
        RMax gameRecurrenceModel j < gameF (s + 1) (s + 1) - 1)
    (hnextDip :
      gameF (s + 2) (s + 2) < gameF (s + 1) (s + 1)) :
    let d := gameF (s + 1) (s + 1)
    let delta := 2 * s - d
    let z := d - 1
    delta + 4 = s →
      ∃ c b0 bz g b1 b2 r,
        z = s + 3 ∧
        c < s ∧ b0 < s ∧ bz < s + 1 ∧
        gameF s c = z + 1 ∧ gameF s b0 = z ∧
        gameF (s + 1) bz = z ∧
        g ∈ EventEDefectBandSlots s delta c b0 ∧
        g < s ∧ g ≠ c ∧ g ≠ b0 ∧
        b1 < s + 1 ∧ b2 < s + 2 ∧
        gameF (s + 1) b1 = gameF s g ∧
        gameF (s + 2) b2 = gameF s g ∧
        0 < gameF s g ∧ gameF s g < z ∧
        r < gameF s g ∧
        gameF (gameF s g) r = gameF s g ∧
        ([g, b1, b2].eraseDups).length = gameF s g - s + 1 ∧
        ThreeConsecutiveHostGeometry s (gameF s g) g b1 b2 := by
  dsimp only
  let d := gameF (s + 1) (s + 1)
  let delta := 2 * s - d
  let z := d - 1
  intro hmax
  have htriple :=
    gameF_margin_eventE_maximal_defect_forces_triple_prefix_value
      hU hdip hmargin hnextDip hmax
  rcases htriple with
    ⟨c, b0, bz, g, hc, hb0, hbz,
      hSucc, hBase, hHostZ, hgBand,
      hgs, hgc, hgb0, hqPos, hqz, hC1, hC2⟩
  rcases hC1 with ⟨b1, hb1, hHost1⟩
  rcases hC2 with ⟨b2, hb2, hHost2⟩
  have hInv := gameF_margin_eventE_parametric_defect_invariant
    hU hdip hmargin hnextDip
  change EventEDefectPacketInvariant s d delta z at hInv
  rcases hInv with
    ⟨_hdeltaPos, _hdeltaUpper, hdeltaSum, hzDiag, _rest⟩
  have hzMax : z = s + 3 := by omega
  have hgeometry :
      ThreeConsecutiveHostGeometry s (gameF s g) g b1 b2 := by
    apply gameF_three_consecutive_prefix_host_geometry
      hgs hb1 hb2 rfl hHost1 hHost2
    omega
  rcases gameF_three_prefix_value_has_completed_rowstart
      hgs rfl ⟨b1, hb1, hHost1⟩ ⟨b2, hb2, hHost2⟩ hgeometry.1 with
    ⟨r, hr, hstart, _hfreezeRegime⟩
  have hcount :=
    threeConsecutiveHostGeometry_distinct_column_count hgeometry
  exact ⟨c, b0, bz, g, b1, b2, r, hzMax,
    hc, hb0, hbz, hSucc, hBase, hHostZ,
    hgBand, hgs, hgc, hgb0, hb1, hb2,
    hHost1, hHost2, hqPos, hqz, hr, hstart, hcount, hgeometry⟩

#print axioms gameF_three_consecutive_prefix_host_geometry
#print axioms threeConsecutiveHostGeometry_distinct_column_count
#print axioms gameF_margin_eventE_maximal_defect_triple_host_geometry

end ChompLean
